description:
What `cu_release._reva_release_note_payload` sends: the release identity
and the repository the page lives in. No `model_config` on purpose — pydantic
ignores unknown keys by default, so an Odoo still sending the retired
`date` / `model_name` / `task_ids` keeps validating.

github_url.description: The release's project repository (https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}); when present REVA reads docs/releases/<slug>.html there instead of scanning the repos mapped to the instance.
github_url.title: Github Url

name.description: Release name; its slug is the docs/releases/<slug>.html stem
name.title: Name

title: ReleaseNoteRequest
